description: The SEMANTICS faculty's COMPREHENSION-IN-READING-CONTEXT piece (graph-native): top-down disambiguation, the word-superiority / Interactive-Activation effect. A recognised symbol ACTIVATES its concept; activation SPREADS along the lexicon (can_follow edges) to PRIME the symbols that may come next; the context-aware reading Term (predict_context_term) then adds lam * the candidate's context_primed to its visual score, so a primed-but-visually-second symbol can win — context corrects an ambiguous read. Two Rules; the priming IS the Rules, the host only stages the sequence and reads back. The lexicon (can_follow edges) is graph data.
